question: A boy introduces a man: "He is the husband of my sister's mother's only daughter." How is the boy related to the man?
solution:
Decoding symbols for Family Tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png] 

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

Break down the statement made by the boy: "He is the husband of my sister's mother's only daughter."

 
• "My sister's mother" refers to the boy's own Mother.
 
• "Only daughter of my mother" refers to the boy's Sister (since she is the only daughter in the family).
 
• Now, replace that part in the sentence: "He is the husband of my Sister."

Family Structure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38c88c54d86b04d1e7391c6e4198a378324b029287c09d09c273b1ea18ba0f9a.png] 

Thus, the man is the Brother-in-law of the boy.
